41 class _BidiAgentLoop:
42     """Agent loop.
43 
44     Attributes:
45         _agent: BidiAgent instance to loop.
46         _started: Flag if agent loop has started.
47         _task_pool: Track active async tasks created in loop.
48         _event_queue: Queue model and tool call events for receiver.
49         _invocation_state: Optional context to pass to tools during execution.
50             This allows passing custom data (user_id, session_id, database connections, etc.)
51             that tools can access via their invocation_state parameter.
52         _send_gate: Gate the sending of events to the model.
53             Blocks when agent is reseting the model connection after timeout.
54     """
55 
56     def __init__(self, agent: "BidiAgent") -> None:
57         """Initialize members of the agent loop.
58 
59         Note, before receiving events from the loop, the user must call `start`.
60 
61         Args:
62             agent: Bidirectional agent to loop over.
63         """
64         self._agent = agent
65         self._started = False
66         self._task_pool = _TaskPool()
67         self._event_queue: asyncio.Queue
68         self._invocation_state: dict[str, Any]
69 
70         self._send_gate = asyncio.Event()
71 
72     async def start(self, invocation_state: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
73         """Start the agent loop.
74 
75         The agent model is started as part of this call.
76 
77         Args:
78             invocation_state: Optional context to pass to tools during execution.
79                 This allows passing custom data (user_id, session_id, database connections, etc.)
80                 that tools can access via their invocation_state parameter.
81 
82         Raises:
83             RuntimeError: If loop already started.
84         """
85         if self._started:
86             raise RuntimeError("loop already started | call stop before starting again")
87 
88         logger.debug("agent loop starting")
89         await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(BidiBeforeInvocationEvent(agent=self._agent))
90 
91         await self._agent.model.start(
92             system_prompt=self._agent.system_prompt,
93             tools=self._agent.tool_registry.get_all_tool_specs(),
94             messages=self._agent.messages,
95         )
96 
97         self._event_queue = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=1)
98 
99         self._task_pool = _TaskPool()
100         self._task_pool.create(self._run_model())
101 
102         self._invocation_state = invocation_state or {}
103         self._send_gate.set()
104         self._started = True
105 
106     async def stop(self) -> None:
107         """Stop the agent loop."""
108         logger.debug("agent loop stopping")
109 
110         self._started = False
111         self._send_gate.clear()
112         self._invocation_state = {}
113 
114         async def stop_tasks() -> None:
115             await self._task_pool.cancel()
116 
117         async def stop_model() -> None:
118             await self._agent.model.stop()
119 
120         try:
121             await stop_all(stop_tasks, stop_model)
122         finally:
123             await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(BidiAfterInvocationEvent(agent=self._agent))
124 
125     async def send(self, event: BidiInputEvent | ToolResultEvent) -> None:
126         """Send model event.
127 
128         Additionally, add text input to messages array.
129 
130         Args:
131             event: User input event or tool result.
132 
133         Raises:
134             RuntimeError: If start has not been called.
135         """
136         if not self._started:
137             raise RuntimeError("loop not started | call start before sending")
138 
139         if not self._send_gate.is_set():
140             logger.debug("waiting for model send signal")
141             await self._send_gate.wait()
142 
143         if isinstance(event, BidiTextInputEvent):
144             message: Message = {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": event.text}]}
145             await self._agent._append_messages(message)
146 
147         await self._agent.model.send(event)
148 
149     async def receive(self) -> AsyncGenerator[BidiOutputEvent, None]:
150         """Receive model and tool call events.
151 
152         Returns:
153             Model and tool call events.
154 
155         Raises:
156             RuntimeError: If start has not been called.
157         """
158         if not self._started:
159             raise RuntimeError("loop not started | call start before receiving")
160 
161         while True:
162             event = await self._event_queue.get()
163             if isinstance(event, BidiModelTimeoutError):
164                 logger.debug("model timeout error received")
165                 yield BidiConnectionRestartEvent(event)
166                 await self._restart_connection(event)
167                 continue
168 
169             if isinstance(event, Exception):
170                 raise event
171 
172             # Check for graceful shutdown event
173             if isinstance(event, BidiConnectionCloseEvent) and event.reason == "user_request":
174                 yield event
175                 break
176 
177             yield event
178 
179     async def _restart_connection(self, timeout_error: BidiModelTimeoutError) -> None:
180         """Restart the model connection after timeout.
181 
182         Args:
183             timeout_error: Timeout error reported by the model.
184         """
185         logger.debug("reseting model connection")
186 
187         self._send_gate.clear()
188 
189         await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(BidiBeforeConnectionRestartEvent(self._agent, timeout_error))
190 
191         restart_exception = None
192         try:
193             await self._agent.model.stop()
194             await self._agent.model.start(
195                 self._agent.system_prompt,
196                 self._agent.tool_registry.get_all_tool_specs(),
197                 self._agent.messages,
198                 **timeout_error.restart_config,
199             )
200             self._task_pool.create(self._run_model())
201         except Exception as exception:
202             restart_exception = exception
203         finally:
204             await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(
205                 BidiAfterConnectionRestartEvent(self._agent, restart_exception)
206             )
207 
208         self._send_gate.set()
209 
210     async def _run_model(self) -> None:
211         """Task for running the model.
212 
213         Events are streamed through the event queue.
214         """
215         logger.debug("model task starting")
216 
217         try:
218             async for event in self._agent.model.receive():
219                 await self._event_queue.put(event)
220 
221                 if isinstance(event, BidiTranscriptStreamEvent):
222                     if event["is_final"]:
223                         message: Message = {"role": event["role"], "content": [{"text": event["text"]}]}
224                         await self._agent._append_messages(message)
225 
226                 elif isinstance(event, ToolUseStreamEvent):
227                     tool_use = event["current_tool_use"]
228                     self._task_pool.create(self._run_tool(tool_use))
229 
230                 elif isinstance(event, BidiInterruptionEvent):
231                     await self._agent.hooks.invoke_callbacks_async(
232                         BidiInterruptionHookEvent(
233                             agent=self._agent,
234                             reason=event["reason"],
235                             interrupted_response_id=event.get("interrupted_response_id"),
236                         )
237                     )
238 
239         except Exception as error:
240             await self._event_queue.put(error)
241 
242     async def _run_tool(self, tool_use: ToolUse) -> None:
243         """Task for running tool requested by the model using the tool executor.
244 
245         Args:
246             tool_use: Tool use request from model.
247         """
248         logger.debug("tool_name=<%s> | tool execution starting", tool_use["name"])
249 
250         tool_results: list[ToolResult] = []
251 
252         # Ensure request_state exists for tools like strands_tools.stop
253         if "request_state" not in self._invocation_state:
254             self._invocation_state["request_state"] = {}
255 
256         invocation_state: dict[str, Any] = {
257             **self._invocation_state,
258             "agent": self._agent,
259             "model": self._agent.model,
260             "messages": self._agent.messages,
261             "system_prompt": self._agent.system_prompt,
262         }
263 
264         try:
265             tool_events = self._agent.tool_executor._stream(
266                 self._agent,
267                 tool_use,
268                 tool_results,
269                 invocation_state,
270                 structured_output_context=None,
271             )
272 
273             async for tool_event in tool_events:
274                 if isinstance(tool_event, ToolInterruptEvent):
275                     self._agent._interrupt_state.deactivate()
276                     interrupt_names = [interrupt.name for interrupt in tool_event.interrupts]
277                     raise RuntimeError(f"interrupts={interrupt_names} | tool interrupts are not supported in bidi")
278 
279                 await self._event_queue.put(tool_event)
280 
281             # Normal flow for all tools (including stop_conversation)
282             tool_result_event = cast(ToolResultEvent, tool_event)
283 
284             tool_use_message: Message = {"role": "assistant", "content": [{"toolUse": tool_use}]}
285             tool_result_message: Message = {"role": "user", "content": [{"toolResult": tool_result_event.tool_result}]}
286             await self._agent._append_messages(tool_use_message, tool_result_message)
287 
288             await self._event_queue.put(ToolResultMessageEvent(tool_result_message))
289 
290             # Check for stop_event_loop flag (set by strands_tools.stop, stop_conversation, or any custom tool)
291             request_state = invocation_state.get("request_state", {})
292             should_stop = request_state.get("stop_event_loop", False)
293 
294             # Backward compatibility: also check for stop_conversation by name (deprecated)
295             if not should_stop and tool_use["name"] == "stop_conversation":
296                 warnings.warn(
297                     "Stopping the event loop by tool name 'stop_conversation' is deprecated. "
298                     "Use request_state['stop_event_loop'] = True instead.",
299                     DeprecationWarning,
300                     stacklevel=2,
301                 )
302                 should_stop = True
303 
304             if should_stop:
305                 logger.info("stop_event_loop=<True> | stopping conversation")
306                 connection_id = getattr(self._agent.model, "_connection_id", "unknown")
307                 await self._event_queue.put(
308                     BidiConnectionCloseEvent(connection_id=connection_id, reason="user_request")
309                 )
310                 return  # Skip sending result to model
311 
312             # Send result to model
313             await self.send(tool_result_event)
314 
315         except Exception as error:
316             await self._event_queue.put(error)
intended_behavior: The method should construct the message dictionary using the role attribute from the BidiTextInputEvent instance instead of hardcoding the role to 'user'. Specifically, change message: Message = {"role": "user", "content": [{"text": event.text}]} to message: Message = {"role": event.role, "content": [{"text": event.text}]}. This respects the event role as intended, allowing different roles such as 'assistant' to be preserved in message history. All other functionality remains unchanged.
